original_benchmark.notes: The fixed evaluation set every system answers in the paper: 8 tasks from each of 37 scenarios plus all tasks of D4 (16), N1 (29) and N2 (27). The original runners make one model call per task. run_claude uses the Claude Code CLI, but as a single call without tools, so it is a model call and not an agent harness.
All 960 tasks in 40 scenarios; eval is a subset. Generated with --split full.

harbor_adapter.notes: Parity experiments have not been run yet. Planned: the full eval split on both sides, pending confirmation of agent, model and number of runs with the Harbor team.
